title: Pretzel Sandwich Buns
description: Pretzel Sandwich Buns made from a small batch of scratch dough.

ingredients.name: baking soda
ingredients.note: For boiling; only the surface residue remains.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Combine {bf}, {milk}, {water}, {butter}, {yeast}, {salt}, {sugar}. Use room-temperature liquids and softened fat. Mix until no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Develop the dough
steps.text: Knead 6–8 minutes until smooth. For wet dough, fold in the bowl with damp hands.

steps.title: Let rise
steps.text: Cover and let rise 45–75 minutes at room temperature until about doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Tuck four dough pieces into tight rounds; set seam down on a lightly greased tray.

steps.title: Proof
steps.text: Cover and proof 15–25 minutes until puffy; a light fingertip dent should return slowly.

steps.title: Prepare the bath
steps.text: Bring {bathwater} to a simmer in a deep pan. Lower the heat and gradually stir in {bath}.

steps.title: Dip the dough
steps.text: Lower one piece at a time into the simmering bath for 20 seconds, turning once. Drain well before placing on the greased sheet.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 410°F on conventional Bake.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Snip a shallow cross into each dipped round and bake until chestnut brown. Allow 19–24 minutes; verify 190°F at the center.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack for 10 minutes under a clean towel for a softer finish.

notes: Make ahead: weigh the dry ingredients the evening before. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Cool completely and freeze sliced or individually wrapped for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: wrap a serving in a damp towel and microwave for 15–25 seconds. Freezer reheat: thaw wrapped, then warm the same way. Serve with soup or gravy for a softer bite. Sodium estimate includes the dough salt; surface uptake from the discarded alkaline bath varies. Allow about 1–2 hours for rising and proofing in addition to mixing and baking. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 272 kcal, 9.6 g protein, 48.7 g total carbohydrate, 3.1 g fat, 2.3 g fiber, 307 mg sodium.
